objective: 3-pair human-information constraint with sequential chain-dependency path construction, trigger transfer, post-trigger tail, and beam diversity
chainReward: small chains are treated as premature firing; actual chain count remains important but no longer lexicographically dominates latent potential
longChainPotential: 0-100 static score combining 2/3-groups, reachable extensions, S-shape construction, human forms, trigger route, queue compatibility, and height pressure
notes: AI preserves exact-3 triggers, evaluates latent extension potential, keeps a potential-elite beam subset, and uses only current+2 NEXT pairs. It does not inspect hidden future pieces.
chainDependencyPath: primary latent-chain signal; evaluates the longest sequential hypothetical trigger path and permits repeated colours such as A->B->A->C
branchPolicy: parallel same-wave removals are not rewarded; a small penalty is applied because they consume material without increasing chain count
